# Outlier measurements

```{r}
NNI_outliers <- N_reflectance_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      r1_nni,
      r6_nni_combined
    ),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "NNI"
  ) %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(NNI, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(NNI, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    Lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR,
    Upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR,
    Outlier = NNI < Lower | NNI > Upper
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

NNI_outliers %>%
  filter(!is.na(NNI)) %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_outliers = sum(Outlier),
    Lower = first(Lower),
    Upper = first(Upper),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

NNI_outliers %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = parameter,
    y = NNI
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "gray",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Outlier),
    width = 0.12,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "blue",
      "TRUE" = "red"
    ),
    na.value = "gray"
  )  +
  labs(
    title = "Potential Outliers in Corn NNI Measurements",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Nitrogen Nutrition Index",
    color = "Potential outlier"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

#

```{r}
NNI_outliers %>%
  filter(Outlier %in% TRUE) %>%
  select(
    any_of(c(
      "study_field",
      "year",
      "stage",
      "group",
      "dap",
      "id",
      "n_treatment"
    )),
    parameter,
    NNI,
    Lower,
    Upper
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    parameter,
    desc(NNI)
  )
NNI_group_outliers <- N_reflectance_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r1_nni, r6_nni_combined),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "NNI"
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(NNI, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(NNI, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    Lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR,
    Upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR,
    Outlier = NNI < Lower | NNI > Upper
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

NNI_group_outliers %>%
  filter(!is.na(NNI)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = group,
    y = NNI,
    fill = group
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Outlier),
    width = 0.12,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "blue",
      "TRUE" = "red"
    ),
    na.value = "gray"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Corn NNI Outliers Across Growth Groups",
    x = "Growth Group",
    y = "NNI",
    color = "Potential outlier"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
